messages:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: deploy started: rollout/sidecar-prop-v3 -> canary(10%) at commit 9f2b7c - ci/build/9876

sara: saw a small spike in 5xxs on inference-proxy-sidecar ~ 12:43 UTC, digging into metrics now (grafana: https://grafana/redwood/d/ae12/proxy-rpm)

ops-bot: INCIDENT opened: SEV-2 - canary causing 5xx/503 for inference-proxy-sidecar - paging eng-oncall

matt (oncall): acked, I'm taking this. Sara can you paste the top errors? are they timeouts or internal 500s?

sara: mostly 503 upstream connect errors and some OOMKill events on sidecar pods in eu-west-1. brief grep from pods: ```kubectl get pods -n infra --selector=app=inf-proxy-sidecar -o wide```

sara: logs snapshot: ```2026-06-03T12:42:58Z ERROR upstream connect failed: connection reset by peer
OOMKilled: process killed by OOM killer```

jordan: I'm seeing kube events that match OOMs + transient attach/detach: ```Events: Warning  OOMKilled  3m (x12 over 6m)  kubelet  Container killed due to memory limits```

matt (oncall): ok - preliminary plan: 1) pause rollout / flip fflag to disable new sidecar path 2) scale down canary traffic 3) rollback if flip doesn't reduce errors. Sara, can you flip the flag? I don't want to run a full rollback until we know flip effect.

sara: flipping feature flag `sidecar_path_v3` -> `off` now via console (audit id: af3-67). deploy-bot, please confirm flag change.

deploy-bot: feature flag `sidecar_path_v3` set to false by sara (audit af3-67) :white_check_mark:

matt (oncall): I'm throttling canary traffic to 0% via traffic-router: `redwood route update rollout/sidecar-prop-v3 --canary 0`

sara: metrics: 3 minutes after flip + throttle: 5xxs down ~65%, OOM events stopped on nodes we observed. still seeing a couple of lingering 503s from older connections.

jordan: even with fflag off there are some pods that hit memory pressure during GC - looks like sidecar config had a new buffer param. I can kick a restart of the remaining canary pods to clear state.

matt (oncall): go ahead and restart the canary pods, jordan. If errors don't continue to drop to baseline in 10m we roll back.

jordan: restarting: ```kubectl rollout restart deployment/inf-proxy-sidecar -n infra --selector=rollout=sidecar-prop-v3```

sara: after restart and throttle, EU error budget returning to normal. Customer-facing error rate reduced from 18% -> 1.2% in EU. That looks like the flip + restart mitigated most impact.

kate: Customer impact note: support reported 6 customers in EU had timeouts for short window (approx 12:42-12:49 UTC). No SLA breaches currently flagged but we should let CS know and open a follow-up incident report.

matt (oncall): agreed. I'm switching to postmortem mode but leaving handoff note for morning oncall. Ops-bot, mark this incident as mitigated and set follow-up required.

ops-bot: INCIDENT 3452106789 status -> MITIGATED by matt (oncall). Follow-up required: root-cause analysis, config diff and memory limit review. Assigning to eng-runtime and eng-ml.

sara: quick root-cause suspicion: new buffer_size default in the sidecar build caused memory growth under certain request patterns; combined with canary env memory limits that were tight. I'll capture the config diff and post in follow-up doc.

matt (oncall): final handoff: jordan (morning oncall) - please monitor eu-west-1 error rate and be ready to roll back if we see a >2% sustained error for 10m. handoff ts: 3452110401.

jordan: acked and noted. I'll pull the list of affected customers and coordinate with CS in the morning.

kate: prepping a short customer-facing blurb for CS; will share in #support after this thread.

sara: saved logs and core dumps to s3://redwood-ops-incidents/3452106789/ and I'll start the config diff doc: https://wiki.redwood/internal/incidents/3452106789

matt (oncall): thanks all. tagging a few entries for follow-up: memory limits, default buffer_size in sidecar config, CI smoke test to exercise high-buffer churn. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ops-bot: Incident 3452106789 -> archived in incidents tracker. Handoff complete.
